correctness.rationale: The eight local domino tilings are exactly the {1,2}-compositions of 5. Their edge-positive counts 5,3,4,3,5 for vertical edges and 3,3,2,2 for horizontal positions preclude a three-edge shattered support, while vertical columns 1 and 4 shatter two. The explicit V3-root depth-three adaptive tree yields 8 distinct response words and the 8-concept cardinality bound is sharp. Each interblock bridge splits even vertex counts, so cannot belong to a perfect matching. Product shattering and 8^m concepts prove the unrestricted 2m/3m formulas; there is no implicit 2-connectedness claim.

value.rationale: Gives an unbounded separation between adaptive and static shattering in the simultaneous natural restrictions of connectedness, planarity, bipartiteness and maximum degree three; the bridge construction preserves graph connectedness while forcing genuine matching-factor product. The exact base gadget and amplification are useful complexity-theoretic witnesses.

final_claim: For every m>=1, a bridge-chain of m two-by-five ladders is connected, bipartite, planar, subcubic on 10m vertices and has perfect-matching edge-concept VCdim 2m and Littlestone dimension 3m.
limitations: Not a claim for 2-connected graphs, all ladder widths, or arbitrary perfect-matching concept classes.
